svg.title: Voxel Dual-Backend — Canvas 2D + WebView WebGL
svg.text: Voxel Dual-Backend (Canvas VERIFIZIERT Default + WebView EXPERIMENTELL — mmd in voxel-dual-backend.mmd)

text.tspan: Mod Layer: mods/voxel_world register voxel { label VOXEL, levels OFF/15/35/50, drawWorld drawFx }
→ PipelineAdapter (priority sel, eligible guard, pushAll/popAll isCanvas)
→ Selection: Probe isWebGL2AvailableInWebView()? false/no warm → Canvas2D Backend
→ Canvas2D (VERIFIZIERT): save/translate/rotate, visibleTiles quads, billboard sprites, drawFx project anchors, worldPresent blur filter
→ Canvas2D Mesh: Heightmap 16×16, Atlas Image reuse, Budget 6ms p95 (bench: 0.0028ms mean)
→ Selection true & warm hit → WebView-WebGL (EXPERIMENTELL): WKWebView ESM Loader fetch three.module.js → FileManager Cache prepared_asset
→ Probe: canvas.getContext('webgl2') cached + invalidate on resize → Bridge postMessage {cam,vw,vh,scale,level} ↔ dataURL/Data
→ Warm Cache 1 Frame voraus: sync drawWorldSync liefert warm → async next Frame im Hintergrund (nie blockierend)
→ Mesh: mod.cache 64MiB / mod.storage:writeBytes 512MiB staged+verified / Importers voxels pack, LOD 8/16/32, Frustum
Asset Pipeline: DocumentPicker .vox/.glb → Thread.runInBackground Decode → mod.cache 64MiB cap (8MiB/file via Guard) → PreparedAsset
→ Governor: ResourceGovernor tickVoxelLOD (critical→OFF, warning→50→35→15→OFF, telemetry p95>budget→downgrade) + tryUpgrade
Telemetry: PipelineTelemetry drawWorldMs p95, triangles, availableFalseRate → AdaptivePerformance HIGH→BALANCED→LOW
Farbe: grün=VERIFIZIERT, orange=EXPERIMENTELL/BENCHMARK. GitHub rendert Mermaid direkt; SVG Fallback ohne Chrome.
